turns.tutor: Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)

Correct: "an" before the vowel sound in "orange". Here is a different one, with a nuance of definiteness.

Write a, an or the: I bought a book. ___ book is very good. (answer with only the missing word)

Correct: "The" fits because the book was already mentioned and both speakers know which one. Try the next one on your own.

Write a, an or the: It is cold. Please close ___ door. (answer with only the missing word)

Correct: "the" fits because both of us know which door.

Recap: use a or an for one new thing, by its first sound ("an" before the vowel sound in "orange"). Use the when the thing was already mentioned or both people know it.
